[P2] Supply the required design note for the public API changes

Removing public exports and changing retry/error behavior falls under CONTRIBUTING.md rule 3, including for experimental APIs. The description explains the removals but does not include or link the required design note covering alternatives and the chosen approach. Return to the design phase under rule 8: record the problem, cause, options, decision and removals, and obtain or link maintainer agreement before proceeding.
